title: Method replaced with None

title: Incorrect generator cleanup
detail: The loop will iterate over the entire generator, which is incorrect behavior. Additionally, raising an exception inside the loop and then closing the generator in the `finally` block can lead to unexpected behavior and resource leaks.

title: Inefficient and incorrect generator handling
detail: Using a `for` loop to get the first value from a generator is inefficient and incorrect. If the generator yields more than once, this will only return the first value and leave the generator in an inconsistent state.
note: A context manager's generator yields once.
